name: Respiratory chain assembly and oxidative phosphorylation
rationale: All members concern building or running the mitochondrial respiratory complexes; unlike the Fe-S cluster and mitochondrial translation confusables, the theme has electron transport and chemiosmotic ATP synthesis.

core: Vitamin B6 and molybdenum cofactor metabolism
name: Vitamin B6, molybdenum cofactor, serine and sulfide metabolism
rationale: Members cover PLP and molybdenum cofactor (prosthetic group) metabolism plus the serine and sulfide reactions they serve; confusables are about transsulfuration, BH4/phenylalanine or general amino acid biosynthesis instead.

name: NTHL1 defects and APEX1 handoff in base excision repair
rationale: All three members concern the NTHL1 glycosylase step and its handoff to APEX1, distinguishing it from OGG1 defects, glycosylase recognition and gap-filling confusables.

core: Regulation of T and NK cell activation
name: Co-receptor tuning of T and NK cell activation
rationale: Members are surface-receptor interactions that set T cell costimulation and restrain NK/T cytotoxicity; confusables emphasise dendritic cell differentiation or KIR/NK cytokine output.

name: Protection of mRNA from decay and translational promotion
rationale: Members inhibit NMD and deadenylation-dependent decay, stabilise mRNAs via IGF2BP/CRD binding and promote translation or export, unlike the miRNA silencing, decapping and stress granule confusables.

qualifier: restraining cell cycle, WNT and YAP1
name: RUNX3 tumour-suppressor transcription restraining cell cycle, WNT and YAP1
rationale: Members are RUNX3 (and FOXO) transcriptional programmes on CDKN1A, BIM, ARF, WNT and YAP1 targets, distinguishing it from TGF-beta/SMAD, Hippo and CDH1 transcription confusables.

qualifier: via HDL-mediated efflux and LDL uptake
name: Cellular cholesterol homeostasis via HDL-mediated efflux and LDL uptake
rationale: Members regulate cellular cholesterol efflux, import, storage, synthesis and foam cell formation; confusables instead cover chylomicron/VLDL handling, intestinal absorption or particle remodeling.

name: IL-4, IL-13 and IL-33 type 2 cytokine signaling
rationale: All members concern production or signaling of IL-4, IL-13 or IL-33, whereas confusables centre on Th2 differentiation, IL-5, mast cells, eosinophils or IgE switching.

qualifier: chondroitin, dermatan and heparan sulfate, with defects
name: Chondroitin, dermatan and heparan sulfate proteoglycan biosynthesis and defects
rationale: Members are linkage-region and CS/DS/HS chain synthesis and their inherited enzyme defects, distinguishing it from keratan sulfate and O-fucose/glucose glycosylation confusables.

qualifier: and sialylation of N- and O-glycans
name: Terminal elongation and sialylation of N- and O-glycans
rationale: Members extend and cap N-glycan antennae and O-glycans (polyLacNAc, sialylation, C1GALT1C1), unlike confusables on O-GalNAc initiation, N-glycan trimming or fucosylated blood-group antigens.

name: Fc-gamma receptor phagocytosis with ITIM inhibitory receptor control
rationale: Members cover FCGR activation and phagocytic cup formation plus CD22, SIRP and Fc inhibitory signaling that restrains B cells and phagocytes; confusables emphasise ADCC, hypersensitivity or BCR activation.

qualifier: with heme synthesis and oxygen transport
name: Erythroid maturation with heme synthesis and oxygen transport
rationale: Members combine erythroid differentiation programmes with heme biosynthesis and oxygen transport, whereas confusables are either heme/Fe-S synthesis alone or erythroid differentiation without the heme arm.

qualifier: fed by glycerol, polyol and fructose metabolism
name: Glycerol, polyol and fructose metabolism feeding acylglycerol synthesis
rationale: Members build PA, DAG, MAG and TAG from glycerol-3-phosphate and include glycerol, alditol and fructose metabolism, which the triglyceride catabolism, phospholipid hydrolysis and glycerol transport confusables lack.

qualifier: atypical and branched linkages by E3 ligases
name: Atypical and branched polyubiquitin chain assembly by E3 ligases
rationale: Members are K6/K11/K27/K29, branched and free-chain ubiquitination by E3 ligases, distinguishing it from deubiquitinase, ISG15 and protein quality control confusables.

qualifier: to TBK1-IRF3 and RIP1 cell death
name: TRIF-dependent TLR signaling to TBK1-IRF3 and RIP1 cell death
rationale: Members are TICAM1/TRIF-mediated TLR3/4 outputs (IKK, TAK1, TBK1-IRF3, programmed death) and their regulation, unlike MyD88/IRAK, NF-kB and NOD confusables.

qualifier: purine and pyrimidine synthesis, salvage, catabolism and transport
name: Purine and pyrimidine synthesis, salvage, catabolism and transport
rationale: Members span de novo, salvage, interconversion, catabolism and nucleoside transport of purines and pyrimidines (including nucleoside-analogue drugs), whereas confusables cover amino acid, methionine/folate or creatine metabolism.

qualifier: synthesis from cholesterol, enterohepatic transport and signaling
name: Bile acid synthesis, enterohepatic transport and signaling
rationale: Members cover cholesterol-to-bile acid synthesis, bile salt transport and recycling, signaling and inherited defects, unlike peroxisomal oxidation, intestinal sterol absorption or xenobiotic/bilirubin transport confusables.

name: FGFR3 activation and signaling with negative FGF feedback
rationale: Members are FGFR3 ligand binding, mutant activation and FRS/SHC cascades plus Sprouty and FGFRL1 inhibition, which the FGFR1/2/4 and PI3K/PLC cascade confusables lack.

name: TGF-beta/BMP and Wnt signaling in mesenchymal progenitor fate
rationale: Members link SMAD, TGF-beta2 and Wnt signaling to mesenchymal stem cell proliferation and differentiation, whereas confusables are committed osteoblast differentiation or cadherin transcription.

name: HDL biogenesis and lipoprotein remodeling in reverse cholesterol transport
rationale: Members are HDL assembly, HDL/LDL remodeling and cholesterol/phospholipid efflux, which distinguish it from confusables focused on ApoA-I signaling, cellular cholesterol sensing and sterol synthesis control.

name: Fc-epsilon receptor I signaling in type I hypersensitivity
rationale: Members are FcεRI-triggered calcium, MAPK and NF-kB cascades in allergy, unlike Fc-gamma receptor confusables or mast cell degranulation/differentiation regulation.

name: MHC class I antigen presentation and its subversion by HIV
rationale: Members are class I processing, loading and cross-presentation plus Nef/Vpu downregulation of MHC I, CD4, CD8 and CD28, distinguishing it from proteasome, MHC class II and PD-L1 confusables.

name: Dendrite arborization and activity-dependent synaptic plasticity
rationale: Members govern dendritic branching, spine and postsynaptic actin remodeling, synaptic translation and NMDAR-RAC1-driven plasticity, unlike postsynaptic density, BDNF/TRK and filopodium confusables.

qualifier: monocyte-macrophage versus granulocyte fate and monocyte identity
name: Monocyte-macrophage versus granulocyte fate control and monocyte identity
rationale: Members regulate monocyte, macrophage, dendritic and granulocyte differentiation and include CCR2/CX3CR1 monocyte signatures, which the CSF signaling and myeloid progenitor confusables lack.

name: Incretin, fatty acid and cholinergic potentiation of insulin secretion
rationale: Members are GLP-1/GIP, FFAR1 and acetylcholine stimulation of insulin release, unlike confusables on adrenergic inhibition, glucagon-type receptors or somatostatin.
